SHARED-F-2-S39.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S39.description: Implement core ConsentService logic governing two-tier consent states, transitions, validation rules, and de-identification triggers. Ensure Tier 1 (basic interaction) vs Tier 2 (data storage) enforcement is deterministic and reusable across services.

SHARED-F-2-S40.title: Consent Persistence and Audit Trail
SHARED-F-2-S40.description: Implement persistence of consent decisions, timestamps, and audit metadata in MongoDB, ensuring traceability for HIPAA compliance. Include linkage to session, user identifiers (if present), and consent tier history.

SHARED-F-2-S41.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S41.description: Develop unit tests for consent tier transitions, validation, and de-identification triggers, along with integration tests validating enforcement across lead capture, unknown question handling, and API entrypoints.
